decisions.what: The info alert renders unconditionally as the first element of SuperchargerStatsContent, not gated on v.Empty or v.Presets (design.md D1).
decisions.why: The guidance is data-independent, so hiding it on an empty window would hide it exactly when a first-time user needs it. One render site also needs no new view-model field.

decisions.what: Task 4.1 also strips StartBatteryPctEst/EndBatteryPctEst from three charging.Session{} fixture literals in supercharger_test.go, though they are not a compile break until tier 2.
decisions.why: The tier's acceptance grep scans test files, so leaving them would produce a false-negative clean grep and hide the fixtures from tier 2's sweep.

decisions.what: This tier corrects kkpa/context/workflows/supercharger-stats-read.md but deliberately leaves verify-session-battery.md's estimator gotcha to tier 2.
decisions.why: The first describes gateway rendering this tier changes; the second states a charging write-path fact that only becomes wrong when tier 2 drops the columns.

decisions.what: The database design gate is recorded as NOT tripped for this tier: no table, column, index, constraint, view or migration change.
decisions.why: Tier 1 is gateway-only rendering and catalogue work. Tiers 2 and 3 own every schema change in this roadmap and will trip the gate themselves.

decisions.what: Waves 1-4 (tasks 1.1-4.1) merged into ONE serial Sonnet worker dispatch instead of four dispatches.
decisions.why: The tier is fully specified mechanical deletion plus one alert insert; four dispatches would re-read the same six-doc pack four times for no added safety.

decisions.what: Repaired TestSuperchargerStatsContent_RendersEnglishHeadersAndNilBatteryValues' em-dash count from `< 6` to `< 4`, which design.md's Test Contract item 4 did not list.
decisions.why: Removing the two Est labels drops the rendered em dashes from 6 to 4, so the untouched threshold would have failed the owner's suite. Templates carry no literal em dash.
